name: dp-sk-judikatura-convert
description: Converts grabbed nsud decisions (API text, PDF text layer, local OCR) into <item>.plan.json load plans with a shape guard that counts personal-data-shaped strings. Writes files only.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read the grab output from dirIn and write <item>.plan.json into dirOut. A decision that cannot be read is recorded as skipped with a reason; the item still ends ok.

items.description: the items to convert, as reported by the detect step

includePdfOnly.description: ingest decisions that only have a PDF (default true)

output.description: { dirOut, converted: [{key, plan, meta}], metrics: {decisions, pdf, ocr, skipped, warnings, pii_flags} }
